question: As of 2022, which of the following is the longest national waterway in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Allahabad-Haldia stretch.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The longest national waterway in India is the **National Waterway 1 (NW-1).**
 
• It is also known as the **Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly river system**.
 
• It stretches from **Prayag Raj(Allahabad) in Uttar Pradesh to Haldia in West Bengal**.
